question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution: The correct answer is "**Abcission"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling is **ABSCISSION **which means the natural detachment of parts of a plant, typically dead leaves and ripe fruits.(किसी पौधे के हिस्सों का प्राकृतिक पृथक्करण, आमतौर पर मृत पत्तियाँ और पके फल) • ***Eg.*** The flower buds and immature fruit frequently drop off; researchers have tried to determine the role growth hormones play in this *abscission*. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Here let's see the meaning of other given words: • **ABSTRUSE **means difficult to understand**.(**समझने में कठिन।**)** • ***Eg*.*** It was an abstruse philosophical essay.* • **INCISION **means a surgical cut made in skin or flesh.(त्वचा या मांस में किया गया सर्जिकल कट।) • ***Eg***. The surgeon makes a small* incision* into which a tube is inserted. • **ABYSSAL** means denoting the depth or bed of the ocean.(समुद्र की गहराई या तल को सूचित करना) • ***Eg***. The Atlantic has* abyssal *depths. 3c:Ta77, The correct answer is **Bright.**
